vista_gallery.visible_lie: Beautiful windows show distant forests, oceans, neon streets, mountains, stars, and a peaceful plague town.
vista_gallery.truth: The Vista Engines make tragedy look composed so visitors keep looking.
vista_gallery.asset_hint: Industrial Parallax background / curated museum vista panes

plague_wing_distant.curator_claim: Pestilence, Faith, and Late Medieval Mortality. Distant view preferred.
plague_wing_distant.visible_lie: Hallowmere appears quiet from afar, with fog softening the streets and bell tower.
plague_wing_distant.truth: The clean distant view hides mud, locked doors, graves, coughs, accusation, and the hospital machinery beneath the chapel.
plague_wing_distant.asset_hint: Medieval Plague Town / Gothicvania Cold Corridors / Sewers Action Pack

underchapel_drain.curator_claim: Transition compression infrastructure. Visitor traversal not intended.
underchapel_drain.visible_lie: A sewer-service route that looks like ordinary drainage below Hallowmere.
underchapel_drain.truth: Plague water, hospital waste, and museum maintenance pipes all share the same impossible system.
